title: fix(plugin-form): a bare-name section entry reads no view-level predicate off the object field (objectui#12719)
body:
Fixes #12719
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`@object-ui/plugin-form` `resolveSectionEntry`, string-shorthand arm (a section entry written as a bare field name): it no longer reads the object field's `visibleOn` into the runtime field's view-level `visibleOn` slot. The published reader stops honouring an object field's `visibleOn` and starts reading nothing new.

- The spec object `FieldSchema` (objectstack `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, strict) declares `visibleWhen` and no `visibleOn`, so no spec-parsed object field can carry the key.
- Producers measured: none write an object field's `visibleOn`. There are zero non-test hits in objectstack `examples/` and services. objectui's non-test `visibleOn` writes are runtime `FormField` and `BaseSchema` slots, not object fields.
- The leg is dropped, not re-pointed to `visibleWhen`. `fromObjectSchema` already carries the object field's `visibleWhen` as the field-level rule, so reading it into the view-level slot as well would evaluate the same predicate twice.
- The README `visibleOn` row now names objectui's runtime slot rather than "spec `FormField.visibleOn`", matching the `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` row PR #12692 corrected.

## Tests

- `sectionFields.test.ts`: a bare-name entry whose object field carries `visibleOn` gets no view-level predicate. Two controls: the object field's `visibleWhen` is carried as the field-level rule, and the object-form arm's own `visibleWhen` still lands in the view-level slot.
- `sectionFields.blankGate-11262.test.ts`: the first CHAINS row (the object schema's `visibleOn`) moves into the "not a chain" block beside the retired `visible_on`, now one table over both keys. Its control is re-pointed to the declared `visibleWhen`, and the docblock says why.
- Ablation: re-injecting the old read turns 6 tests red (the new pin and the 5 `visibleOn` not-a-chain rows). The restored blob `f4574d31` equals HEAD.
- At head `787711f`: 195 test files and 2629 tests pass (plugin-form plus every console, app-shell and core family that names `sectionFields`, `resolveSectionEntry` or `blankGate`). plugin-form type-check is green. changeset-claims, changeset:check, test-path-roots, spec-symbols, new-line-citations and changeset presence all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: live reading, reason: no producer of the key.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12719-section-shorthand-visibleon.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-form: minor`, breaking semantics in the body. What a raw object schema loses: a field carrying `visibleOn` no longer hides where a section lists it by name. The fix: write `visibleWhen` on the object field.

## Acceptance notes

- The `ObjectForm.tsx` docblock "FormField `visibleOn` (spec FormFieldSchema CEL expression)" carries the same stale wording, but it is outside this claim's surface. Carrier: none.
- Out of scope, per the claim: the object-form arm, the runtime `FormField.visibleOn` slot, and the designer dialect (#12696 remains closed and is untouched).
